title: AA 20 cm delivery CFD brief
status: Four concept geometries generated. OpenFOAM screening and refined-mesh spot checks executed; quality and convergence are recorded in results. No validated winner.
question: Why did tested extensions remove perceived cooling, and which change improves useful cooling at 20 cm?
required_inputs: Measured geometry including internal passages and open area
Under-flow source pressure and cold mass flow for both configurations
Total temperature or a justified recovered-temperature measurement
Exit velocity profile or a documented inlet-profile assumption
Ambient temperature and wind; hot-exhaust arrangement
Temperature/velocity map at 20 cm with uncertainty
unknown_inputs: Leave unknown. Sensitivity scenarios must be labeled assumptions, not AA predictions.
model: RANS screening with validated mixing and model sensitivity
Compressible internal region if pressure ratio/Mach require it
Separate downstream model only with consistent measured exit conditions
outputs: Delivery and pressure loss at measured source states; source changes assessed from measurements or a separate validated source map
Internal pressure loss and separated flow
Target-plane temperature, velocity and cold-source fraction maps
Coverage on a specified target area
Heat removal on a controlled heated patch
Cold-air use and energy per useful cooling dose

decision_logic.finding: Cold mass flow falls or total temperature rises with extension
decision_logic.next: Fix source/attachment interaction before external jet optimization.

decision_logic.finding: Source state remains similar but target delivery falls
decision_logic.next: Compare geometry, alignment and wind protection.

decision_logic.finding: Target receives cold flow but heat removal is inadequate
decision_logic.next: Evaluate available source capacity and exposure area.

later_candidates: Sweep the existing vortex control setting to compare useful cooling and cold flow before adding more extensions.
Higher cold flow through an appropriately sized outlet, using the measured vortex performance curve
Short open wind shield, checked for recirculation
Closer cold-source mounting if installation permits
excluded_claims: No claim that all extensions warmed the air; no temperatures were measured.
No claim of optimum exit speed, comfort or system efficiency.
No internal vortex simulation in first stage.
completion_requirement: A design ranking must survive input uncertainty and agree with measured baseline behavior.
source_model_status: User-confirmed Jeanoko 08 micro + magnetic base, B094HTCQP8. Use vortex-reference.json for provisional specifications; EXAIR data are not its performance map.
source_coupling_limit: A downstream model with prescribed cold mass flow/total temperature cannot predict how attachment backpressure changes the vortex split or source flow. Measure both configurations or couple a validated empirical source map.
required_inputs_for_rough_start: Enough reference material available. Missing dimensions and source conditions become explicit parameters. Measurements are required later for validation, not to start rough cases.
required_inputs_label: For reconstruction and validation of actual AA hardware; not gates for the rough study.
model_used: Low-Mach Boussinesq RANS screening. Ideal-gas attempts rejected. First-order final convection, tight pressure/scalar solves.
